name: Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor Co., Ltd. (成都蓉酒酒业有限公司)
via: Chengdu Industrial Investment Group holds 51%, the controlling stake; the company's actual controller is the Chengdu Municipal SASAC
note: Chengdu liquor platform established November 2025 with 500 million yuan registered capital, owned by five state-owned shareholders; its core brand is 萬世珍水 (Wanshi Zhenshui). Announced by Chengdu Rongcheng FC on 18 May 2026 as a 2026-season strategic partner whose brand is to appear on the first-team shirt chest.
